The function was found by an image-wide screen (tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_value_equality_census.py, promoted this run), not by name: it is one of only 2 hits among 91 pure register-field candidates across 2842 equal-size functions, and the other hit was an already-pinned canary. The mechanism is exactly the CameraSupervisor mechanism in the GPR bank: both streams materialise ONE zero and copy it into mirrored registers — the target does `li r5,0` then `addi r3,r5,0` (zero rooted in r5, index copied from it), we do `li r3,0` then `addi r0,r3,0` (index first, zero copied into r0) — so the positional pairing of the definitions binds root-to-root and every later use of the other member of the web is refused. NV's residual text describes this precisely; what was missing was a state shape that can hold a many-to-many correspondence.
